name: Biomass and waste-to-energy
applications: cogeneration at palm-oil and agro-industry sites
principle: Solid biomass or municipal waste is burned on a grate or in a fluidised bed to raise steam for a turbine, or gasified to a fuel gas. The IEA guide rates small-scale biomass gasification (bio-syngas) at TRL 9; no source read so far gives power-plant efficiency or cost.

process_steps.name: Combustion on grate or in fluidised bed
Steam turbine and flue gas cleaning

source.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Biomass gasification - small-scale (bio-syngas)' 9 (2025)

sources.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, bioenergy entries
